name: Lake Baikal
description: Lake Baikal in southern Siberia is the world's oldest and deepest lake, formed some 25 million years ago and plunging to about 1,640 metres. It holds roughly a fifth of the planet's unfrozen fresh water, more than all the North American Great Lakes combined. Its long isolation has produced thousands of species found nowhere else, earning it the nickname "Galapagos of Russia.
